title: Functionalizer：面向子词分词的无损功能分解
summary: 提出Functionalizer无损预分词框架，将大小写、变音符号和字符重复等拼写变化分解为Unicode私用区的操作码/操作数前缀流，完全可逆。在六种语料上减少词汇表需求达16%，在代码序列上压缩长度并提升语法有效性，但会膨胀自然语言序列长度。
summary_en: The Functionalizer is a lossless pre-tokenizer framework that factors orthographic variations (casing, diacritics, repetition) into reversible opcode/operand prefix streams encoded in the Unicode Private Use Area. Across six corpora it reduces vocabulary slot requirements by up to 16%, compresses indentation-heavy code while inflating prose, and improves code syntax validity in 25M-parameter GPT-2 scale models.
